digestRules.inputDigest: Opaque Java-issued immutable report/input token. Worker stores and echoes; no recomputation.
digestRules.checkInputDigest: Opaque Java-issued current semantic state token. Distinct from worker model bundle digest.
digestRules.serverCanonical: Java AnalysisStateJournal: UTF-16 lexicographically sorted object keys, no whitespace, array order preserved, unescaped Unicode/no NFC normalization, JSON null, finite plain minimal decimal numbers.
digestRules.workerBundle: Existing Python json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) including default spaces, before adding input_digest. Grid v4 bundles have no question_refs. Metadata only, never authorization.
digestRules.idempotency: Server hashes operation + typed command (null fields retained); scope excluded for same-input cross-generation semantic replay, except COMPLETE includes scope. Publication keys are report-wide across branches.

gridCases.name: v4-length-at-most-unit
gridCases.meaning: L <= U gives one segment [0,L) with full context.

gridCases.name: v4-exact-multiple
gridCases.meaning: L = 12 = 3U: n = 3, each cut is the newline position nearest to kL/n inside its window.

gridCases.name: v4-no-newline-fallback
gridCases.meaning: No U+000A inside a window: cut = max(t, lo+1).

gridCases.name: v4-newline-tie
gridCases.meaning: Newlines after positions 4 and 6 are both 1 from t = 5: the smaller position wins.

gridCases.name: v4-crlf
gridCases.meaning: Only U+000A counts, so a cut falls right after \n and never splits \r\n.

gridCases.name: v4-non-bmp-code-points
gridCases.meaning: Offsets are Unicode code points; one emoji is one position.

gridCases.name: v4-context-clipped-both-ends
gridCases.meaning: Context is clipped to [0, L) on both sides.

gridCases.name: v4-unit-one
gridCases.meaning: U = 1 gives one segment per code point.

gridCases.name: v4-unit-two
gridCases.meaning: U = 2: n = 3 with windows of about L/n code points.

gridCases.name: v4-25000-three-segments
gridCases.meaning: 25,000 code points with a newline every 50 give 3 segments cut at the newline nearest to kL/3; the target is targetRepeat.unit repeated targetRepeat.count times.

authorCorrectionProofs.projectionAuthority: author_correction is null; raw plural proof metadata is trusted-server transport only, never wildcard time/condition authority.
authorCorrectionProofs.disagreementPolicy: DB_RAW_DISAGREEMENT remains NEEDS_CONTEXT in v1. Actual CURRENT_VALUE correction is recorded and applied to new frozen baseline, but free-text narrative time/condition authority is never inferred.

execution.runtimeDefault: DISABLED; no implicit historical backfill. Explicit START/RECHECK same-key recovery or RETRY queues ready reports.
execution.completion: Only current completed checks, completed typo segments, and server-derived fully covered NO_CHECK segments count as successful processing. Planner/read/grid preparation alone is not PARTIAL. Both full required grids and all current checks are required for COMPLETED.
execution.publicResultBoundary: Only status/counts/coverage summaries/check summaries/findings/verified source quotes. No full evidence_bundle, catalogue, checkpoint, lease or provider usage-call ledger.

retryBudgetPolicy.trigger: Explicit same-input author RETRY only; automatic lease recovery (expire) continues the same run
retryBudgetPolicy.runCaps: Role caps count usage rows with validationGeneration >= validation_jobs.run_start_generation and status not RELEASED. ValidationJob.retry() sets run_start_generation to the new generation; expire() never changes it. The Worker's InvocationBudget (modelCalls, lookups, seconds) stays per claim attempt.
retryBudgetPolicy.legacyConfiguration: A job without configurationVersion 2 is legacy: budgets.setting is rebuilt from the properties, budgets.typo too except its stored segmentChars/contextChars, PLANNER and JUDGE models are rebuilt, a stored TYPO model is kept, retired roles RELATED_SELECTION and COVERAGE are dropped, configurationVersion becomes 2 and budgetHistory records it. The SETTING branch is discarded when the stored grid is not v4 or the configuration is legacy; the TYPO grid is kept.
retryBudgetPolicy.replay: Original immutable RETRY response_snapshot, no new generation/budget refresh
retryBudgetPolicy.optionalEmbedding: QUERY_EMBEDDING model/cap come from the explicit configuration; a run never reuses query embeddings across retries (each run starts its own RAG cache).

bootstrapOrder: claim: trusted scope, contractVersion 1, projectionVersion 2, configurationVersion 2, models, budgets, existing checkpoint
GET checkpoint is permitted with gridReady=false and does not read any source
full T1 READ_SOURCE: validated text (no modelClues)
SUBJECTS: one subject catalogue read at start (no paging)
SETTING: every PLANNER segment in parallel, each published as soon as it is valid; then the v4 grid segments must equal the local split (GRID_SEGMENTS_MISMATCH), then MERGED_PLAN
SETTINGS: current rows of the questions' subjects in batches of at most 100 subjects
JUDGE: four questions at a time; publish each DECIDED unit with its evidence_bundle and the current server checkInputDigest
TYPO runs independently with its fixed v1 segments and publishes each successful TYPO segment

PLANNER.rules: Only PLANNER stages exist for target segments in grid v4. `rules`, `clue_checks` and every draft `lookup_intents` must be absent. Every span lies in the segment core [start,end) (the context is read-only). status is PLANNED iff questions is non-empty.

MERGED_PLAN.rules: questions[].originalRefs are only PLANNER:TSEGn:<local_ref>; state is {draft, lookup_obligations: []}; merge key unchanged (subject_refs set, property_or_rule, time_context, conditions set, assertion_mode); spans of merged drafts are kept in segment order.

savedSeedRecovery.sameInput: Verify original seed hash/fingerprint, unchanged target and full frozen source row/lifetime metadata under Work, reuse materialize, queue same report/baselineRevision
savedSeedRecovery.rawSourceRead: No S3 under the Work recovery lock; leased source reader verifies actual bytes before models/publication

execution.plansBoundary: SETTING only (PLANNER, MERGED_PLAN); TYPO_SEGMENT must use /units classification/suggestion/coverage validation. /plans TYPO returns 400 without any stage/publication/version write.

comparisonEvidenceBoundary.target: T1 context or an E-ref whose actual source_ref is T1 remains valid context, but cannot authorize CONFLICT/SUSPECTED_CONFLICT
comparisonEvidenceBoundary.allowed: A validated frozen fact or E-ref whose actual verified frozen source is not T1

payloadCitationPaths.canonicalSettings: settings[] must exactly equal the server-issued known entry projection; text/quote inside that authenticated state are ordinary domain keys
payloadCitationPaths.otherCopies: text/quote in undeclared payload/checkpoint objects are invalid; typed spans/context still require exact supplied citation and actual source hash/position checks

queryEmbeddingIdentity.reservation: QUERY_EMBEDDING requires queryInput; every generation role requires null. Immutable validation_call_input belongs to the original ValidationJob usage request. Replaying a requestId with another identity is rejected.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.queryHashRule: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 query sent to the provider; no trim, Unicode normalization or case folding.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.versionSource: Existing chat.retrieval-embedding-version, including explicit override; dimensions are existing retrieval_chunks vector(1536).
queryEmbeddingIdentity.reuse: Within one run only: the corpus reuses the successful receipt of an identical stripped query (reused_from) without a lookup or embedding call. No reuse across retries.
queryEmbeddingIdentity.deny: A failed, partial or not-ready search is never reused; the role caps of the run stay authoritative.

indexFill.meaning: Owner decision 2026-11-02: at intake the validation run fills only the gaps of its frozen RAG scope (prior episodes and the setting-book revisions marked currentRevision) before judging; works that never submit a validation are never touched.
indexFill.optional: A claim without any INDEX_EMBEDDING model or cap fills nothing; a role that is present but differs from the index or has no positive cap is EMBEDDING_CONFIGURATION_INVALID. The server accepts INDEX_EMBEDDING only together with QUERY_EMBEDDING.
indexFill.scope: Frozen manifest sources with sourceKind EPISODE, plus sourceKind SETTING_BOOK with currentRevision true (the book's current, non-archived revision at intake). Past revisions stay provenance only.
indexFill.manifestCurrentRevision: Every SETTING_BOOK manifest row written at intake carries a boolean currentRevision.
indexFill.gapRule: A source is complete when its header equals the frozen key/version/hash and chunk policy and every chunk is a valid READY vector of the index model/version; complete sources are skipped without reading text. Otherwise the full text is read through READ_SOURCE, cut by cl100k-800-100-boundary-v1, an intact chunk set is kept (a changed source is re-chunked, never mixed) and only chunks that are not READY are embedded.
indexFill.timing: The fill runs while planning; judging waits for it, then reads readiness once. VECTOR is offered only when every scope source is fully embedded.
indexFill.failure: A provider error, role cap, writer-database error, source change, timeout or unreadable source ends only the fill: judging continues and a question that needs a search ends INCOMPLETE with failure_code VECTOR_INDEX_FILL_FAILED and a failure_cause INDEX_FILL_*. Without a writer connection or role the code stays VECTOR_NOT_READY. Lease loss and input changes still stop the run.
indexFill.chunkDigestRule: SHA-256 of the batch's chunk_hash values joined by a newline, in chunk order.
indexFill.reservationRule: INDEX_EMBEDDING requires indexInput and no queryInput; every other role sends no indexInput. inputDigest/manifestHash/index identity must equal the job, sourceRef must be a frozen EPISODE or currentRevision SETTING_BOOK source and sourceHash its contentHash. Embedding roles are bounded by their per-run maxCalls/maxReservedTokens, not by the branch inputTokens. Service-paid usage holds and charges 0 on the author's account; raw tokens stay in the ledger.
indexFill.evidence: A setting-book chunk becomes an E ref of that SETTING_BOOK source (source_kind SETTING_BOOK, source_context revisionNo/referenceTimeKind/referenceEpisodeNo); the server verifies its quote by slicing the hash-verified full setting-book text like any other citation.
indexFill.usageView: The usage view keeps its v1 keys: an INDEX_EMBEDDING row shows its bound indexInput under queryInput (the immutable call-input column).

subjectCatalogueVector.meaning: SUBJECTS groups the frozen baseline entries exactly like the server settings projection: S refs in first-seen subject order, the first entry of a subject supplies domain and name, aliases are the ordered union over that subject's entries. SETTINGS returns the projection rows of the requested subjects whose domain is characters or worldSettings, in B order; worldHistory rows are never returned.

configurationV2.meaning: Job configuration written in one place on the server (queue time and legacy upgrade). The claim carries configurationVersion, models and budgets. PLANNER, JUDGE and TYPO each need {model, reasoningEffort in none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh} and roles[R].outputTokens >= 1, otherwise the Worker fails with EXECUTION_BUDGET_CONFIGURATION_INVALID. Per call reservedTokens <= budgets[branch].inputTokens + roles[role].outputTokens.

calls: 1 OPEN: draft, target_context (±300 code points per span), compact current rows of the question's subjects (characters/worldSettings only), receipts L BASELINE/COMPARISON_CONTEXT (evidence_refs = those B refs) and L TARGET_CONTEXT/COMPARISON_CONTEXT. Answer DECIDED or FOLLOW_UP with search_queries (omitted from the schema when search is unavailable) and/or context_requests {start,end} on T1.

FOLLOW_UP: each query is one VECTOR search {kind: COMPARISON_CONTEXT, operation: VECTOR, purpose: 판정이 요청한 의미 검색, query} with top-k searchLimit; each context request is a TARGET_CONTEXT receipt (no lookup). The next call is FINAL (DECIDED only).

DECIDED SUSPECTED_CONFLICT before the call limit without a successful CHANGES_EXCEPTIONS VECTOR receipt: one Worker VECTOR search {kind: CHANGES_EXCEPTIONS, operation: VECTOR, purpose: WORKER_CHANGE_SEARCH_PURPOSE, query: unique subject_mentions then property_or_rule}, then the next call is FINAL.
judgeFlow.workerChangeSearchPurpose: Worker가 충돌 의심 판정 전에 요구하는 변화·예외 검색
judgeFlow.ragReuse: Within a run, a VECTOR query is keyed by its stripped text; a reused result gets a new L ref with reused_from and spends no lookup and no embedding call.
judgeFlow.noEpisodes: No RAG sources (no prior episode and no current setting book): VECTOR succeeds with no evidence, readiness.vector_status=NOT_APPLICABLE, no embedding.
judgeFlow.notReady: RAG sources (prior episodes, current setting books) but no fully ready index: search is not offered and a needed change search fails the question with VECTOR_NOT_READY, or VECTOR_INDEX_FILL_FAILED when the intake index fill failed.
judgeFlow.suspectedRule: SUSPECTED_CONFLICT needs a receipt in completion.changes_exceptions.receipt_refs with kind CHANGES_EXCEPTIONS and operation VECTOR.
judgeFlow.bundleSettings: The bundle settings ref set equals the entries of the question's subject_refs whose domain is characters or worldSettings (plus BASELINE obligation refs, always empty in v4).
judgeFlow.publishedDecision: ValidationDecision shape with follow_ups [] and affected_question_refs [].

questionFailure.decision: Owner decision 2026-11-02 (③): a question that cannot reach a decision because of a question-level error is published alone as an INCOMPLETE unit and the other questions are still judged.
questionFailure.runLevel: Budget, input/source change, gate stop, quota, lease/HTTP and data access failures still stop dispatching new judges; judges already running finish and publish. A failed INCOMPLETE publication is itself run-level.
questionFailure.payloadRules: action and outcome are INCOMPLETE; failure_code is a safe code ([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,99}); failure_cause is null or a safe code; failed_call is the judge call 0..3 it failed on; target_spans equal the check draft's target_spans as a set and are cited like any span. No other key.
questionFailure.server: The check keeps outcome INCOMPLETE and is not completed(): no finding is created, the run cannot be COMPLETED, and results show incompleteChecks plus each INCOMPLETE check's failureCode, failureCause and verified targetSpans.
questionFailure.completion: The Worker reports Complete.failureCode SETTING_QUESTIONS_INCOMPLETE when the SETTING branch judged every question it could; a run-level SETTING code or a TYPO branch failure code takes precedence. The server derives PARTIAL (FAILED when nothing succeeded) as for any incomplete run.
questionFailure.retry: The author's same-input RETRY re-judges only INCOMPLETE and unpublished questions from their first judge call on the same check revision; published decisions are kept. A Worker lease recovery also re-judges them within the same run caps.

workerUnusedRoutes.meaning: Grid v4 Workers never revise checks or save a runtime checkpoint; the examples stay valid server input.
